Corrected the Mission Bay Branch Library's completion milestone -- the existing entry gave a rough 2005 year from a weak DataSF Assessor guess. SFPL's own "Facts & Figures" PDF, already checked directly and confirmed in the second Gemini-verification pass, states the actual grand opening was July 8, 2006, and adds a Dec 10, 2003 groundbreaking as a real earlier stage. This was verified but never actually applied to the data in that earlier pass -- caught while double-checking the data-quality report.

Mission Bay Branch Library added as a real, active Assessor-parcel record (blklot 8708110, 960 4th St, built 2005) -- the Assessor tax roll's own property_location field for this blklot reads '201 BERRY ST', a stale corner-frontage address rather than the library's current 4th St address, the same kind of discrepancy already documented for The Exchange on 16th.
